text:
Nora H: Quick heads-up  Meridian Health requested a 7-day POC for chart summarization + retrieval QA. Requirements: VPC peering, customer-managed KMS, p95 <160ms, budget target $0.60 / 1k tokens, ~120k tokens/day. Can we scope model variants and infra blockers?

Amir V: For summarization + retrieval I'd recommend testing two variants: mpt-12b-qlora (higher quality) and mpt-12b-q4_0 (latency/cost optimized). To hit p95 <160ms we should plan for a dedicated A100-40g shard with prefix KV caching and short max_seq (1024).

Carlos M: Tokenization caveat  Meridian's EMR ingestion includes unusual control chars. We need a 1k de-identified note sample to run token-diff and ensure prefix cache alignment. AE can they provide that?

Nora H: I'll ask AE to request a 1k sample + security questionnaire answers. They also want embedding stability across variants for nightly re-indexing.

Amir V: Use our stable 1536-d embeddings for retrieval. We'll run 500 pairwise cosine checks between q4_0 and qlora to quantify drift. I'll prepare a small notebook.

Carlos M: Ops: VPC peering + customer KMS supported. Need infra request for dedicated shard. Estimate: 1 x a100-40g for baseline; bump to 2 x a100 for parallel evaluation. Provisioning ~72 hours after approvals. POC reserved premium ~18-22%.

sec-bot: Please attach SOC2 Type II report and the latest penetration test summary. Note: KMS options include AWS KMS CMK (customer) and BYOK via HSM for Private deployments. Confirm if Meridian requires FIPS/HSM-only.

Nora H: Action items: (1) I will request notes + security answers; (2) Amir will run tokenizer + embed drift checks; (3) Carlos will open infra request for dedicated shard & VPC peering; (4) Amir to draft POC runbook and cost estimates.

Amir V: Draft POC config below (iterate after token sample):

```yaml
model: mpt-12b-q4_0
fallback: mpt-12b-qlora
instance: a100-40g-dedicated
kv_cache: prefix_enabled
max_seq: 1024
quant: q4_0
vpc_peering: true
kms: aws-cmk-customer
monitoring: console + token-traces
slo_p95_ms: 160
```

Carlos M: Infra ticket SALES-5902 created (POC Meridian dedicated shard + VPC). infra-bot linked infra/poc-meridian.

ops-bot: Created ticket SALES-5902 and attached provisioning checklist.

Nora H: I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with Meridian tomorrow 11am PT to confirm requirements and request the sample. @Amir V @Carlos M please join.

Amir V: I'll bring the tokenizer checklist and the embed-drift notebook.

Carlos M: I'll bring infra timeline and provisioning slide.

Nora H: :thumbsup: Closing thread after kickoff.
